messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi John, your order's paid and still to ship. The Magic Miner 40T ships November 30, 2026, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA in the same order.

You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

And noted on your email, nothing was cancelled, your order is untouched. Anything else I can check?
Wanted to make sure my initial cancel request through email is ignored!
Handed to the team · Making sure the earlier cancel email isn't processed by anyone on the team.

Done, John. Your cancel email is dead in the water, nothing was processed and the order stands exactly as it was. I've also told the team directly so nobody picks that email up later.

So you're set: Magic Miner 40T, shipping November 30, 2026.
Before you go, one thing: what changed your mind about cancelling, was it just the power draw you could dial down, or something else?
Power draw. I live in New York and the power prices are high but realized with this unit I can lower the power a bit
Makes sense, the 40T runs 30 or 40 TH/s and you pick. Follow-up: what rate are you paying per kWh in New York, and is there a monthly power number you're trying to stay under?

34 cents is steep, that's about as high as it gets in the US. Good news is the 40T is the best value per TH we sell, and dialling it to 30 TH/s pulls the power down with it, so you're in the right unit for New York.

Thanks for telling me, that's genuinely useful.

Happy to have helped, John. If you were pleased with the service, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And you're welcome in our Discord for product news and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
